name: Artemis Shackleton Crater Outpost
tagline: Establish humanity's permanent foothold at the Lunar South Pole.
description: Command a lunar surface outpost on the rim of Shackleton Crater. Balance high daytime solar energy against deep shadow cycles, abrasive electrostatic lunar dust, intense unshielded cosmic radiation, and crater water-ice harvesting.

environmental_constraints.atmosphere: Vacuum (0 kPa) — Zero atmospheric radiation or thermal buffering

major_hazards: Solar Particle Events (SPEs) with zero atmospheric shielding
Lunar South Pole grazing-angle shadow periods reducing solar output by 78%
Electrostatic razor-sharp lunar regolith degrading seals and solar panels
Total reliance on closed-loop water recycling and crater ice extraction

objectives.title: Maintain crew survival for the full mission duration
Keep Oxygen reserves above critical threshold (10 kg)
Construct or upgrade at least 2 additional outpost facilities
Accumulate at least 40 Planetary Science Points
